newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Feb 21.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Feb 21.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Bunker prices were steady in thin trading with shipowners withdrawing several earlier enquiries due to unchanged offers. Traders said sellers did not lower their offers in a quiet cargo market where there were no bids or offers.
Sources said an independent sold 380-cst at $99.50 per tonne but the majors were maintaining at $102.00.
